FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Compatibility with Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Update's Empire's compatibility with Vanilla Base Generation Expanded, including a transpiler fix to an out-of-bounds error in the Vanilla Expanded Framework.

patchNoteLines.li: Add transpiler patch to fix an out-of-bounds error during VBGE map generation
Fix the spawning of defense turrets for settlements that have weapons production
Extensiblity: tithe injections are properly reflected in the "net income" display on the settlement window

patchNoteImageDescriptions.li: Compatibility with Vanilla Base Generation Expanded

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Additional extensibility support
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Lets submods 'inject' extra value into a settlement's tithe budget.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds an ITitheBudgetModifier interface that WorldObjectComps can implement. Allows for 'injection' of additional value into a settlement's tithe budget for a given resource

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Major Refactor
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updating version during major refactor.

patchNoteLines.li: Reworked FactionColonies class and the settings
Added a LogUtil class
Refactored settlements to use a single WorldSettlementFC class
Settlement types and resources defined through XML defs
Major UI rework (redid most of the mod's windows)
Road buildings uses a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) for more organic-looking road networks
Faction policies and traits converted into defs
Repurposed old, unused policies into three new categories of Edicts
Reworked events to give the player a choice over how they respond
Reworked taxes: a snapshot of a settlement's production is taken each day. At tax time, the player recieves taxes based on the average of these daily snapshots
Numerous bug fixes to the manual battle system. It has been tentatively re-enabled. If it remains buggy, it may be disabled again
Military threat levels reworked. Settlement raids scale more
Numerous changes in the name of extensibility (refer to the Docs)
Compatibility patches for Humanoid Alien Races, Combat Extended, RimWar, World Domination, and Faction Territories & Vassalage. Some still need testing
Numerous other bugfixes; too many to note here

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building Menu Overhaul and Stability Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Major improvements to the building menu system, expanded biome support, enhanced road functionality, and numerous critical bug fixes for improved stability.

patchNoteLines.li: Building menu has had an overhaul, You can now resize and filter buildings
Alpha biomes support - Pecha
Neolithic Buildings - Pecha
Roads should be working much better now
New roads provide an alert when built
Fixed infinite loop crash in tax system with safety checks. Fixed PawnGen errors upon delivery + Safe delivery location coordinate error.
Fixed a stack overflow error when opening the Create Settlement screen caused by infinite recursion in IsInAnyShuttleRange
Fixed PawnGenerationRequest "incorrect constructor" errors in FCPawnGenerator
Fixed Critical XML Definition Errors - Policy System Repair
Fixed version tracking and red outline display issues
Enhanced patch notes window visual design
Improved code stability and asset loading
Better user experience with branded default imagery

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
